findings.message: primary_context.json is a single global file with no session-id, PID, or lockfile. Any dadaia context activate call from any process overwrites it, leaking state across concurrent Claude Code sessions.

dadaia context use prints export DADAIA_CONTEXT=<name> but does not execute it. Inside Claude Code sessions env vars are not persisted across tool calls, making the isolation mechanism effectively inert.
Resolution order confirmed: DADAIA_CONTEXT env var (ctx-inject.sh line 11) takes priority over primary_context.json. Isolation is possible if operator exports the var at session start.

decisions_required: Approve fix option (b): hook detects CLAUDE_SESSION_ID and uses session-scoped override file. Requires product-engineer to create a hotfix spec before software-engineer implements.
Confirm whether CLAUDE_SESSION_ID is a stable env var in Claude Code runtime, or select PID as fallback session key.
